$schema: Kestrel design tokens v1. Source of truth for every color, space, radius and type style. Edit here, then run `npm run tokens`; never hand-edit src/tokens.css.

surface.usage: Cards, panels, chat bubbles from the assistant, chart surfaces.

surface-2.usage: Nested or recessed areas inside a surface: code, tool steps, table hover.

border.usage: 1px dividers and card outlines. Never use for emphasis.

text-muted.usage: Metadata, captions, timestamps. Not for anything the user must read to act.

accent.usage: The one primary action per view, focus rings, active navigation.

accent-2.usage: Gradient partner of accent, brand mark only.

accent-soft.usage: Background of selected items, citation chips, intent chips.

accent-text.usage: Text and links on accent-soft or surface.

user-bubble.usage: Background of the buyer's own chat messages.

series-1.usage: Chart series 1. Categorical order is fixed: 1, 2, 3.

series-3.usage: Chart series 3. Below 3:1 on light surface: always pair with a visible value label.

good.usage: Status: success, in stock, passed. Always with an icon or label, never color alone.

warning.usage: Status: fallback used, backorder, partial. Always with an icon or label.

warning-soft.usage: Background of warning badges and fallback trace steps.

critical.usage: Status: error, blocked, failed gate, out of stock. Always with an icon or label.

critical-soft.usage: Background of critical badges and error messages.

1.usage: Gap inside chips and icon-label pairs.

3.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

4.usage: Card padding on mobile; page gutter on phones.

sans.value: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

default.usage: Raised cards on the page background. Dark mode uses borders instead.
